typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Alex jumped straight into the bed. The room in Hotel Ionia was very cozy and comfy.*
"I know we came here to train but this place is so nice!"
*Alex jumps around on the bed, her energetic self can't help it, she has to spend that energy somewhere.*
"There's only one bed... That means we will sleep together! Yay!"
*Suddenly there's a knock on the door. Raboot instantly stops being so hyper. Her shy demeanor around strangers was another trait she had. A voice called out.*
Stranger: "Dear guest, there's been a problem with you reservation, could you please come to the front desk? This might take a couple of hours..."
Alex: "Aww... It's ok... I'll manage on my own!"
*Raboot's face blushed for some reason. But that doesn't matter now. As Raboot sees you leave, she waits a couple of minutes before she starts attending to her "urges".*
*Back in reception*
Stranger: "We are so sorry dear guest! We will make it up to you!"
*As it turns out, it wasn't you who had issues with the reservation. And so, back to the room, it was pretty late after all. As the door to your room was in front of you, faint moaning could be heard...*

/Open the door normally
/Open the door in a panic
/Take a slight peek carefully
/Continue hearing
/Leave
